decisions.reason: As a distant and only lightly featured product, submarine interior lighting likely falls below the firm's aspiration for a growing core-oriented portfolio, so management would reallocate its resources to nearer opportunities despite having some organisational slack.

The medical examination light builds on the firm's lighting capabilities, fits its innovation path in efficient specialist luminaires, and as an expanding large firm it can tolerate early uncertainty while evaluating its market performance.
Industrial explosion-proof luminaires strongly match the firm's industrial customer base and technical strengths, so their strategic fit and dedicated market presentation justify keeping them.
The designer task light is close to the established offer and was relaunched as a popular product, suggesting performance at or above aspiration and little reason to withdraw it.
